adjudication_summary: Source-reviewed worker-2/4/6 re-review recovered source-supported activity/toxicity rows, reconciled linked DBAASP/dbAMP rows while preserving database-only conflicts, exhausted the local XML/PDF/OA/supplement/database surfaces, and accepts the paper with cautions and no open rework target.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Figures 3, 4, 5, 6, and 7 contain plotted values, but XML/PDF text gives only summary IC50/max/specificity/toxicity statements; final rows do not invent graph-only point estimates.
The local supplementary .bin assets are Springer article/support HTML pages and no structured supplementary assay table was recoverable.

dbAMP rows include broad/aggregated target text and values tied to other PMIDs; unsupported database values are retained as source_conflict or database_only_no_primary_source rather than source-verified rows.
The paper supports entry inhibition and an author-proposed fusion-rearrangement hypothesis, but not direct binding-site, structure, or fusion-intermediate assays.
Peptide toxicity prose says 100 mg/ml, while Figure 7 caption and database row use 100 ug/ml; final toxicity row uses the caption/database-supported ug/ml context and notes the prose typo.

supplementary_assets.note: Local supplementary assets are HTML/article/support pages; no source-supported assay spreadsheet or supplementary table is recoverable.

per_layer_decision_rationale.final_decision: Previous rework codes full_source_review_not_completed, database_conflicts_require_adjudication, and no_supported_activity_rows_extracted are resolved; unsupported database-only values are preserved as cautions, not blockers.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Worker-4 matched DBAASP WN83 toxicity/WNV/DENV rows to primary source evidence and preserved dbAMP broad/aggregated rows as source_conflict or database_only_no_primary_source.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 extracted 17 source-supported activity/toxicity/control rows from Table 1, dose-response prose, specificity/toxicity prose, figure captions, and database row context.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Worker-6 preserved entry phenotype and author-proposed fusion-rearrangement mechanism as bounded mechanism context without promoting it to direct binding or structural proof.

merged_database_rows.coverage: DBAASP assay/experiment/literature rows and dbAMP linked experiment rows reconciled against primary Table 1, results prose, specificity/toxicity sections, and article metadata.

oa_package.coverage: PMC package NXML/PDF plus figure images 1-7 were inventoried; XML/PDF/captions carry the supportable values.

paper_pdf.coverage: PDF text cross-check for Table 1, dose-response, specificity, toxicity, and methods lines.

paper_xml.coverage: article metadata, abstract, Table 1, Table 2, results, methods, figure captions, and discussion.

supplementary_assets.coverage: Ten landed supplementary .bin files were file-typed and searched; they are HTML article/support pages rather than assay spreadsheets/tables.
